What We Do

Complete Painting
& Construction Solutions

From multi family exteriors to new construction interiors, King Painting delivers complete coating and carpentry solutions at every scale.

Multi Family Painting

Garden style, wrap around, and mid rise exterior and interior painting programs. We understand how GCs and property managers operate.

Hardi & Stucco

Expert Hardie board replacement and stucco repair on large scale residential and commercial properties. Durable finishes that hold up.

Carpentry

Structural and finish carpentry for construction and rehab projects. Seamlessly integrated into our full coating scopes.

New Construction

Full paint programs for builders from initial priming through final finish coat. We keep pace with your schedule.

Rehab & Renovation

Older building restoration handled with an eye for detail and code compliance.

HUD / Certified Payroll

Experienced on government funded and prevailing wage projects. Full documentation, compliance, and certified payroll submissions.

Who We Are

A Contractor
You Can Count On

King Painting LLC was founded by Gil Krengel in 2003. Gil entered the construction industry in 1997 as a regional project manager for a local general contractor, building a deep foundation in both new construction and rehab work. That experience shaped a company that doesn't just paint it manages projects with the discipline of a seasoned GC.

Today, King Painting operates across Texas and neighboring states, tackling everything from single story residences to boom lift required mid rises. Every crew member wears a King Painting branded identification shirt and follows job specific safety protocols because Gil believes the jobsite reflects the company.
